product.name: Confidential Computing Platform
product.description: A confidential computing platform and control plane that protects data and AI models while they are in use inside trusted execution environments across clouds and environments.
product.positioning: A single control plane for confidential computing stacks that helps enterprises secure data-in-use and AI workloads across CPUs and GPUs.

features_and_capabilities.name: Trusted execution environment management
features_and_capabilities.description: Creates and manages trusted execution environments for AI infrastructure and other workloads.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Uses a single control plane to configure, attest, and monitor confidential computing environments.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Helps enforce security, sovereignty, and compliance while reducing exposure of data and AI models in use.

features_and_capabilities.name: Integrity verification and secure key release
features_and_capabilities.description: Verifies firmware and software integrity before allowing secure key release.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Uses composite attestation across CPU and GPU components to check that workloads run in trusted environments.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Reduces gaps between independently managed components and helps ensure keys are only released to trusted workloads.

features_and_capabilities.name: Centralized operations for confidential computing
features_and_capabilities.description: Lets teams provision, configure, and monitor confidential computing infrastructure from one place.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Provides one control plane for workflows and policies across the confidential computing stack.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Eliminates management complexity and fragmented tooling while supporting scale.

features_and_capabilities.name: Cross-environment deployment in secure enclaves
features_and_capabilities.description: Allows organizations to enroll cloud or on-premises computing resources and deploy existing applications inside secure TEEs.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Deploys existing applications within a secure TEE in minutes.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Speeds adoption of confidential computing without development or integration costs.

differentiators: Acts as a control plane for confidential computing across clouds and environments rather than only providing infrastructure availability.
Supports composite attestation across CPU and GPU components from a unified control plane.
Provides a fast path to deploy existing applications in secure TEEs in minutes with no development or integration costs.
Supports both on-premises and SaaS deployment models.

customer.target_customer: Enterprises and highly regulated organizations that need to protect sensitive or personal data and AI workloads while data is being processed.
buyers: Head of Data Security and Compliance
users: ML engineers running confidential AI workloads
problems: Sensitive data is most exposed while it is being processed.
Organizations handling high-value or regulated information need stronger protection than a cloud provider's limited built-in data security.
Teams need to share or use sensitive data for AI and collaboration without exposing it.
Managing confidential computing infrastructure across environments can create operational complexity and fragmented tooling.
use_cases: Protecting data in use for machine learning models and AI workloads.
Securing healthcare AI and access to sensitive clinical data.
Sharing data with third parties in a confidential compute environment.
Protecting blockchain, crypto wallets, and NFTs in fintech and crypto contexts.
desired_outcomes: Protect data and AI models while in active use.
Meet privacy, compliance, and data sovereignty requirements.
Reduce unauthorized access and malicious tampering risks.
Improve collaboration and innovation with sensitive data.
existing_alternatives: Relying on a cloud provider's limited data security controls.
Using confidential computing infrastructure that primarily focuses on infrastructure availability within a single cloud ecosystem.

customer_stories: BeeKeeperAI uses Fortanix Confidential Computing to accelerate healthcare AI and enable secure healthcare data collaboration.
Goldman Sachs is cited by Fortanix as a customer and partner in financial services content.
company_expertise: Fortanix says it has 100+ security patents, 30+ papers in top conferences, and presenters at USENIX, CCC, and Blackhat.
Fortanix says it is a founding member of the Confidential Computing Consortium of the Linux Foundation.
product_evidence: Fortanix describes Confidential Computing Manager as a single control plane for managing secure enclaves, integrity verification, and protection of data and AI models in trusted execution environments.
Fortanix says confidential computing protects information when it is being processed using hardware-based trusted execution environments or physical enclaves that keep data encrypted at runtime.
proprietary_insights_or_examples: Fortanix describes composite attestation across CPU and GPU and lists support for Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, and NVIDIA Blackwell and Hopper.

writing_style: Uses technical security terms alongside business outcomes
Frequently frames security in terms of protecting data while in use
terms_or_claims_to_avoid: Avoid absolute security claims such as unhackable, unbreakable, or 100% secure
Do not state specific patent counts
